name: Maker Hip
author: Maker Hip
tagline: eight tracks of sounds, easy to follow
description: STACK 0.1.0-test: a test build. Eight tracks, each with one sound from a single list; the keys play the selected track; four knobs shape it (pitch, a DJ filter, decay, level); a basic 16-step page. Nothing is saved yet.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0), from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hugelton Instruments). Sounds: Maker Hip's Rock kit; the Hugelton Sample Pack by Leo Kuroshita (CC0); Versilian Studios VCSL (CC0); two sounds rendered from Felucca presets (temporary).
